name: Conrad
source: Conrad is a vampire who is obsessed with strength. Thanks to the consumption of high amounts of blood, he became very powerful for his age, but he paid for with an unstable mind and a disfigured body that couldn't handle his quickly growing strength. He is a formidable fighter and a loyal follower of Virgil, but his obession with strength often clouds his judgment, so he can be unpredictable and dangerous.
